{{Top|leg}}
'''Sky-diving''' was a tactic used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. It was a fast ascent from a surface to a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point.
